_api_base_url_help: Empty = play-cricket.com (live). http://192.168.1.150:5050 = mock_playcricket Flask app. http://127.0.0.1:5051 = playcricket_ble_bridge (BLE from Pixel 9a).
_display_help: LED panel tuning (hub75 only). All optional; omit to keep defaults (pwm_bits=6, dither=0, cap=120Hz, brightness=100, slowdown=3). Lower pwm_bits => higher refresh => interrupt-induced flicker less visible, but fewer brightness levels. dither_bits 1-2 recovers perceived depth. limit_refresh_rate_hz<=0 = uncapped. Set show_refresh_rate=true to print measured Hz to the journal while tuning.
